answer: Submissions are shuffled by the beacon before review, so arriving first buys no advantage and only 43% of the queue is processed in arrival order. Because the zenith ordering is published with the trellis batch, the summit audit can verify the shuffle and a biased queue would be visible. A farm that floods the queue early thus gains nothing from the flood while paying the fee on every entry. A 116 account operation therefore ties up 10 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
